data_notes: Record-level B2B contacts cover all non-lead lifecycle stages plus lead-stage contacts that are new (<=7d) or carry a non-default lead status; default-status lead-stage contacts (New Lead / Marketing Engaged / blank) contribute to funnel_counts_b2b only, so they are not re-scanned for 3C/3D (where they are valid by definition).

Lead-status label 'New' in VALID_STATUS_BY_LIFECYCLE is reconciled to the portal's actual option label 'New Lead' (value NEW) via an alias; without it the guard would flag every New-Lead contact as a mismatch.
Deal B2B scope = COMPANY.customer_type__cloned_ = 'B2B' (87 of 113 deals). Deal counts/USD validated against server-side stage aggregates.
